verdict.rationale: Blaxel's docs say sandboxes resume from standby in under 25ms, even after weeks. They also say new sandboxes deploy from images "in seconds", which covers both the sub-second and few-second ends of the story. Missing for 10: a precise documented cold-start figure for fresh creation (as opposed to standby resume), and independent or hands-on benchmark corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start sandboxes with documented sub-second-to-few-second cold starts

citations.quote: Sandboxes resume from standby in under 25 milliseconds and automatically scale to zero after a few seconds of inactivity.
resume from standby under 25ms even after weeks.
Deploy new sandboxes from images in seconds.
